purpose: Investigation checklist for resolving MF-001 and MA-001 manufacturing findings

investigation_steps.description: Review original CAD geometry for handle dimensions and branding placement
investigation_steps.acceptance_criteria: CAD geometry documented with explicit dimensions

investigation_steps.description: Review CAM setup for stock-top reference and operation types
investigation_steps.acceptance_criteria: CAM stock setup documented, operation types confirmed

investigation_steps.description: Verify engraving operation type (engrave vs contour vs pocket)
investigation_steps.acceptance_criteria: Correct operation type selected for branding

investigation_steps.description: Determine intended engraving depth for ECO-TOOL branding

investigation_steps.acceptance_criteria: Stock thickness specified in mm and inches

investigation_steps.description: Simulate contour operation against specified stock
Simulate engraving operation at corrected depth
Regenerate NC file from corrected CAM setup if required
investigation_steps.acceptance_criteria: New NC file generated and verified
investigation_steps.notes: Only required if CAM corrections are made

investigation_steps.description: Run test cut on scrap stock
investigation_steps.acceptance_criteria: Test cut matches expected geometry and depths
investigation_steps.notes: Optional but recommended before production run

resolution_criteria.MF-001: All INV-001 through INV-004, INV-007, INV-008 complete with accepted evidence
resolution_criteria.MA-001: INV-005, INV-006, INV-007 complete with accepted evidence

not_ready.description: Known unresolved manufacturing blockers. Production should not start.
not_ready.exit_criteria: All open findings resolved or moved to accepted risk

conditional_ready.description: Manufacturing path validated. Known operator instructions or monitoring requirements remain.
conditional_ready.entry_criteria: Core findings resolved, operator cautions documented

ready.description: Controlled specification exists. Toolpaths validated. Simulation completed. No special production cautions remain.
ready.entry_criteria: All findings closed, specifications approved, simulation verified

notes: This checklist defines the investigation path for MF-001 and MA-001
Each step requires evidence before marking complete
Evidence records should reference RE-* resolution evidence IDs
Do not mark findings resolved until all required steps are complete
